description: Publish or schedule an asset to one or many connected social accounts. Pass publish_targets for several accounts at once (each with its own optional caption and post type), or publish_platform + publish_account_id for one. publish_scheduled_at schedules the post; leave it empty to publish now.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

publish_account_id.description: Single-target account id from list_social_accounts. Ignored when publish_targets is set.

publish_caption.description: Caption applied to every target that has no caption of its own. Falls back to the asset's own caption when empty.

publish_platform.description: Single-target platform (twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, linkedin, youtube). Ignored when publish_targets is set.

publish_post_type.description: Default post type for every target: reel, feed or carousel. Defaults to reel.

publish_scheduled_at.description: When to post. ISO-8601 (2026-11-20T18:42:00Z or +01:00) or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+0000'. Leave empty to publish now.

publish_targets.description: Publish the same asset to several accounts in one call. Each entry is one platform/account pair; account ids come from list_social_accounts. Omit (or send []) for a single target and use publish_platform/publish_account_id instead. A per-entry caption overrides publish_caption for that account.

platform.description: twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, linkedin or youtube.

post_type.description: reel, feed or carousel. Defaults to publish_post_type.

publisher_pid.description: Audience Resolver project id the asset belongs to.

name: publish_asset
